member.summary:
Adds Service Bus message prioritization with explicit event parameter types. Recommended for V13+ - pass EventProviderOptions.Value.ParameterTypes directly.
Example for V13+: services.AddOptiServiceBusPrioritizer( sp => sp.GetRequiredService<IOptions<EventProviderOptions>>().Value.ParameterTypes, options => { ... });
